deliverables: WP1 - Enabling Onchain Payments & Card Infrastructure
Open-source on-chain payments infrastructure including smart contracts, account abstraction, batched transactions, and settlement logic
Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances
Stablecoin-backed banking rails and compliance architecture
Milestone-based disbursement controls and reporting obligations
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, with project funding later transferred to a Project-Specific Smart Contract for Wirex work.
request.what: Withdraw treasury funds for Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex, funding open-source payments infrastructure, Visa card integration, banking/stablecoin rails, wallet/API integration, and related oversight/administration.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,961,538 ada, consisting of 3,846,153 ada for WP1 and a 115,385 ada Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Wirex addresses a claimed gap in Cardano by providing infrastructure for everyday spending, merchant acceptance, and fiat-connected financial activity.

The proposal will deliver full-stack open-source payments infrastructure enabling onchain settlement through smart contracts and connections to banking rails, stablecoin systems, and wallet interfaces.
A core outcome is Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances, enabling users to spend digital assets globally at millions of merchants.
Wirex has proven execution capability with 7 million users, more than 1.5 million cards issued, more than $20 billion in transaction volume, and Visa Principal Member experience.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain submission under the Budget Process Framework.
The requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ada Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Audit, administration, independent oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are included through Intersect and technically capable third parties.
Wirex has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

Funds will be managed through Intersect's 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract with stated multisignature permissions, external oversight entities, dashboard tracking, and on-chain verifiability.

summary: The document requests 3,961,538 ada for a Wirex payments-infrastructure proposal submitted by Intersect, emphasizing open-source payment rails, Visa card integration, Cardano adoption, Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, and smart-contract-based treasury administration.
